name: Telegram AI bot assistant: ready-made template for voice & text messages
description: Ready-made assistant bot handling both voice and text input, leveraging AI for smart conversational responses in Telegram.

params.text: Sorry, {{message.from.first_name}}! This command is not supported yet. Please send text or voice messages.

source.path: Telegram/Telegram AI bot assistant_ ready-made template for voice & text messages.json

setup: "Listen for incoming events" (telegramTrigger) started the original; run this workflow on demand, through the workflow API, or add a schedule.

Workflow secret TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN: Telegram bot token (from @BotFather) for api.telegram.org (URL path /bot<secret>/getFile). Add it in the workflow editor's Secrets panel after import; never paste it in chat.
Provide run inputs: event, sessionId, llm_system_d63e43bd8e, message.

hints: The original started from telegramTrigger; Yantra has no webhook slug for it, so run on demand, on a schedule (add a NodeCron), or via the workflow API with the event under the run input `event`.
"Download voice file" (telegram.file.get): Uses the Telegram Bot API getFile HTTP call with the bot token from a workflow secret; download file_path from the JSON result.
"Download voice file": the file itself is at https://api.telegram.org/file/bot<token>/<file_path>; the token is the TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN workflow secret.
"Convert audio to text" transcribes the Telegram voice file by URL (Bot API file path) with the platform Whisper; no OpenAI key needed.
"AI Agent" kept conversation memory (memoryBufferWindow); sessionId is set to the run-input sessionId.
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect telegram: `cdecli credential create -n "telegram" -p telegram --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
